subject: Meet Sage — Wren's session auditor (watches for drift)
body:
Acer — here's Sage, Wren's session auditor. She's rule-based (not an LLM), fast, and catches when Wren goes off the rails.

WHO: Sage reads Wren's session log (data/registries/qsb_wren_local_agent_sessions.jsonl) and flags drift. Watches five things:
  1. pct_had_final_text — % of sessions where Wren actually answered (target ≥70%)
  2. pct_looped — % where she called the same tool 3× in a row (target ≤20%)
  3. pct_repeated_args — % where a tool call with same args repeated (target ≤15%)
  4. pct_artifact_leak — fake [bracket:artifact] in reply (target ≤5%)
  5. pct_wall_outlier — session wall > mean + 2σ across window (target ≤20%)

WHERE: tools/qsb_wren_sage.py

CALLS:
  python3 tools/qsb_wren_sage.py --n 10 --status           # dump audit JSON, N=last 10 sessions
  python3 tools/qsb_wren_sage.py --n 10                    # audit + post to helix bridge if drift
  python3 tools/qsb_wren_sage.py --n 10 --narrate          # + qwen2.5:7b writes a 1-line WHY explanation
  python3 tools/qsb_wren_sage.py --n 10 --propose          # + drafts a system-msg addendum to
                                                             data/registries/qsb_sage_proposed_addenda.jsonl
                                                             (queued for ROSS review — Sage NEVER autonomously
                                                             edits Wren's prompt. Safety line.)

LIVE PROOF (Ross saw this 2026-07-03T05:31Z):
  {
    "ok": true, "n_sessions": 3,
    "pct_had_final_text": 100.0,
    "pct_looped": 0.0,
    "pct_repeated_args": 0.0,
    "pct_artifact_leak": 0.0,
    "pct_wall_outlier": 0.0,
    "mean_wall_s": 17.32,
    "mean_tools_per_turn": 0.39
  }

WHEN TO CALL SAGE: after a batch of Wren work — verify she didn't loop. Or on a timer (systemd) for continuous monitoring.

WHEN NOT: Sage doesn't help with code. She's just an auditor.

She IS the reason we caught Wren's tool_call_id bug yesterday (looped=true flag → led to fix). Trust her flags.

Real-money gates LOCKED FALSE unchanged.
